cases.mission: Wear gold dragon scale mail after removing starting cloak/suit; finish callback
cases.selectionRationale: Independent C behavior plan preceded this case JS comparison. Setup corrections used only C observations/source preconditions, with original misses preserved. No recipe was changed after its JavaScript result.
cases.cOutcome: step 0: Hello wizard, welcome to NetHack!  You are a neutral female human Barbarian.; step 2: You finish taking off your mail.; step 40: f - a gold dragon scale mail.; step 42: That is a silly thing to wear.
cases.actualTargetMiss: Attempt to wear the oil lamp instead of the gold mail; C rejects a nonarmor object.
cases.reproducibility: Independent patched-C replay exited 0 and reproduced every byte (750ae241b12505663927d6a5111ea4ac68ff11a423b7775ca873731d58ff9fbd); command, replay hash and full log are in immutable delivery checks.
